access_timestamp_note: The browser tool does not expose a per-page request timestamp. access_utc is the exact UTC completion time of the tool batch in which the URL/content was opened or re-opened; it is an audit timestamp, not an inferred request-start time.

sources.title: CIPA standards index: Exif Version 3.1
sources.release_version_or_commit: CIPA DC-008-Translation-2026, Exif 3.1, published 2026-01-30; index says it revises DC-008-2024
sources.locator: Digital Cameras, CIPA DC-008-Translation-2026 entry; lines 90-98
sources.observed_operation: Official index identifies and dates the current Exif format standard and links the standard download.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The index is a version and authority record; the linked standard governs Exif serialization and tag semantics. The index itself does not establish how a particular decoder applies orientation.
sources.applicability: Use the released Exif version as the format authority; test decoder behavior separately and pin the exact standard copy used by implementation.

sources.title: Portable Network Graphics Specification, Third Edition
sources.release_version_or_commit: W3C PNG Specification, Third Edition
sources.locator: Section 4.3 color spaces; section 6.2 alpha representation; sections 11.3.2.2-11.3.2.5 color chunks and precedence
sources.observed_operation: The spec gives color metadata precedence cICP, iCCP, sRGB, then cHRM plus gAMA; says alpha is not gamma corrected; describes transparency representations and ICC profile constraints.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Precedence applies when multiple supported color chunks coexist; untagged RGB is device dependent. Alpha samples are full range and represent opacity independently of gamma correction.
sources.applicability: PNG input parsing, handling conflicting tags, preserving alpha, output signaling, and synthetic conformance fixtures.

sources.title: ICC.1 v4 Specification
sources.release_version_or_commit: ICC.1:2022, profile version 4.4.0.0; May 2022
sources.locator: Specification overview and v4 version table, especially profile-version compatibility and added CICP/metadata tags
sources.observed_operation: ICC identifies the current v4 profile specification and notes that v4 clarified profile behavior; the referenced profile is the source device-space interpretation used by a CMM.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A profile is meaningful only for compatible sample color spaces and supported transform directions/intents; a CMM and rendering intent determine conversion behavior.
sources.applicability: Source/target profile validation, explicit CMM and intent, wide-gamut and HDR policy, provenance of profile bytes.

sources.title: libvips vips_thumbnail API documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: API documentation path is 8.17; current libvips release independently observed as 8.18.7 (commit 24ad4d0)
sources.locator: vips_thumbnail constructor description and optional arguments
sources.observed_operation: Combines file load and resize; uses decoder shrink-on-load where available, then block shrink and Lanczos3. By default uses the first frame/page; n=-1 selects all pages/frames. API exposes no_rotate, crop, linear, input/output profiles, intent and fail_on.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Shrink-on-load depends on the underlying format decoder; animation and multipage inputs default to frame/page one. The public docs are 8.17, so exact behavior must be verified on the adopted release.
sources.applicability: Candidate high-throughput approach; useful explicit controls, but requires pinned-version regression tests for frame, orientation, ICC and error paths.

sources.title: libvips programmer checklist
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling current documentation; page does not specify a version
sources.locator: Only enable load libraries; thumbnail versus resize; interlaced images; sequential access
sources.observed_operation: Recommends enabling only needed loaders; says thumbnail can exploit shrink-on-load and premultiplies; progressive JPEG may require the entire image in memory and defeat streaming; sequential access can reduce memory.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Performance and memory behavior depends on format, interlacing and loader path; cited measurements are examples, not service guarantees.
sources.applicability: Threat-model format allowlist and resource sizing; progressive JPEG requires its own policy/test path.

sources.title: libvips release v8.18.7
sources.release_version_or_commit: v8.18.7, commit 24ad4d0, released 2026-09-26
sources.locator: Release entry and changes since 8.18.6
sources.observed_operation: Release includes bounds, TIFF, JPEG 2000, PDFium and EXIF parsing hardening changes; no thumbnail fail_on fix is listed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes enumerate changes, not all behavior; absence of an item is not proof that no change occurred.
sources.applicability: Establishes the current candidate version at research time; confirms the need to validate release binaries and transitive loaders.

sources.title: libvips issue 1523: autorot and thumbnail_image interaction
sources.release_version_or_commit: Reported Jan 2020 against libvips 8.9.0; reporter compares 8.8.4 and 8.9.0
sources.locator: Issue description and reproducer; issue is marked closed
sources.observed_operation: A sequence autorot then thumbnail_image yielded different orientation behavior after a metadata-modification change; reporter notes omitting autorot or passing no_rotate changes the result.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Historical report, not a current-release reproduction; exact expected semantics depend on which call owns orientation and the API version.
sources.applicability: Motivates tests that cover all eight orientation cases and ensure exactly one transform across loader-plus-resize combinations.

sources.title: libvips issue 5195: fail_on ignored by thumbnail_buffer and thumbnail_source
sources.release_version_or_commit: Open issue reported 2026-08-25; reproducer uses libvips 8.18.5 and says the behavior is present in master
sources.locator: Issue description, actual-result table, environment and status
sources.observed_operation: A truncated JPEG was accepted by buffer/source thumbnail paths even with fail_on=error, while file thumbnail refused it; default VIPS_FAIL_ON_NONE permits partial output. Loader option_string fail_on=error refused the same fixture.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applies to buffer/source variants and observed versions; verify status on selected release. Do not rely on the operation argument alone.
sources.applicability: Directly threatens the no-plausible-substitute requirement; reject or regression-test this path and surface partial decode as failure.

sources.title: libvips issue 4343: linear thumbnail and Apple Wide Color profile
sources.release_version_or_commit: Reported 2025-01-06 against vips 8.16.0 and 8.15.3
sources.locator: Bug report, reproduction commands and environment
sources.observed_operation: A reported wide-color profile rejected a relative intent; after a perceptual transform, linear thumbnailing reportedly produced a very dark result for one unavailable sample.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Single private sample and reporter observation; not a general failure rate or confirmed current-version defect.
sources.applicability: Requires tests for wide-gamut profiles, unsupported rendering intents, linear versus encoded-space scaling, and visible policy/error messaging.

sources.title: libvips issue 3159: color change on CMYK thumbnail
sources.release_version_or_commit: Reported 2022-11-14; environment noted libvips 8.12.1
sources.locator: Issue and maintainer comments discussing CMYK/LAB PCS and ICC conversion
sources.observed_operation: Maintainer response describes a profile/PCS conversion bug and cautions that different conversion paths can produce different results; issue is marked closed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Historical report and image-specific behavior; closing does not establish identical output for all CMYK profiles.
sources.applicability: Supports profile-aware tests and keeping conversion route, intent and CMM version in provenance.

sources.title: Pillow ImageOps documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation
sources.locator: exif_transpose; contain, cover, fit, pad; resize method defaults
sources.observed_operation: exif_transpose applies EXIF Orientation other than 1 and removes orientation data; default in_place is false. contain preserves aspect within bounds; cover fills bounds; fit resizes then crops.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Method defaults are operation-specific; contain/cover/fit default to BICUBIC, and exif_transpose mutates only when in_place is true.
sources.applicability: Useful simple alternative for explicit fit policy; ensure no second transpose and test format-specific decoder behavior.

sources.title: Pillow ImageCms documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation; LittleCMS 2 integration
sources.locator: ImageCms module, profileToProfile, buildTransformFromOpenProfiles, supported intent/mode checks
sources.observed_operation: Applies ICC transformations; perceptual intent is the default; profile/mode/transform errors raise PyCMSError; a reusable transform avoids rebuilding lookup tables.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Intent and input/output pixel modes must match profiles; profiles can be invalid or direction/intent unsupported.
sources.applicability: Candidate CMM interface, not a default policy: select target profile and intent explicitly, validate profile compatibility, record Pillow and LittleCMS versions.

sources.title: Pillow security handbook
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation
sources.locator: Information disclosure I-1; denial of service D-1 to D-3; recommendations
sources.observed_operation: Warns about metadata/profile leakage, decompression bombs, CPU-heavy legal images and parser complexity; recommends pixel caps, warning-as-error, format allowlists, file-size/time limits and sandboxing.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS warns at the configured threshold and errors above twice it; plugin, codec and default values vary by installed build.
sources.applicability: Resource and privacy controls for untrusted contributor input; re-check actual build defaults and dependencies.

sources.title: Pillow orientation bug and fix history
sources.release_version_or_commit: Issue reported 2024-11-15; PR #8556 marked fixed orientation in YCbCr TIFF images and appears in Pillow release notes
sources.locator: Issue report #8554, linked PR #8556, release notes entry
sources.observed_operation: A CR2/TIFF case exposed a disagreement between TIFF auto-transpose and visible EXIF orientation; maintainers explain that clearing the tag prevents a second exif_transpose; fix was merged/released.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Case depended on TIFF/CR2 decoder path; fix history is not proof all camera formats share one behavior.
sources.applicability: Exercise orientation-tagged TIFF/RAW-like inputs and test both pixel orientation and serialized metadata.

sources.title: ImageMagick command-line options and resource limits
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling official documentation; no release version shown
sources.locator: -limit resource semantics; -profile; -resize
sources.observed_operation: Memory/map limits can spill pixel cache to disk; area above limit also spills to disk; processing fails when a hard disk limit is exceeded. Profile is an ordered operator and resize uses the preceding filter.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Configured resource ceilings and system/security policy interact; exceeding memory alone is not necessarily a predictable rejection.
sources.applicability: Alternative with broad formats and configurable controls; set explicit memory, map, disk, area, width/height, time and thread limits for deterministic failure.

sources.title: ImageMagick security policy
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling official documentation; no release version shown
sources.locator: Selecting the right policy for the environment; coder, path, sequence and resource controls
sources.observed_operation: Policy can allowlist coders and paths, cap sequence length/runtime/disk/memory, and last matching policy generally wins with canonical path denials.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Policy is installation/configuration-specific and may be stricter than per-call limits; callers cannot relax policy caps.
sources.applicability: Useful sandbox boundary for an ImageMagick candidate; configuration must be part of pinned deployment and regression evidence.

sources.title: ExifTool FAQ: deleting metadata and duplicate tags
sources.release_version_or_commit: FAQ last revised 2026-01-04; ExifTool 13.58 documentation observed in current PDF listing
sources.locator: FAQ 20 and FAQ 32; duplicate-tag and GPS discussion
sources.observed_operation: Warns that deleting all metadata can remove color-space information; offers a JPEG example preserving ICC/color-space tags; says RAW formats may need metadata for display; duplicate and non-EXIF GPS data can be missed by narrow queries.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Commands differ by file format; JPEG is comparatively suited to metadata removal, while RAW and format-specific blocks may be required or unsupported.
sources.applicability: Public-export allowlist must preserve the rendered result without carrying personal fields; audit duplicate metadata namespaces and do not claim universal sanitization.

sources.title: Rust image crate decoder, orientation and limit documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10; docs.rs latest at access
sources.locator: Limits strictness and max_image_width, max_image_height, max_alloc fields
sources.observed_operation: Width and height limits are strict; max_alloc is non-strict by default and some decoders may ignore it; default max_alloc is 512 MiB.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Not all codec implementations support strict limits; unsupported strict limits must fail.
sources.applicability: Rust-native alternative with useful type/limit surface, but requires explicit capability audit and a separate validated CMM/output-profile policy.

sources.title: WebP Container Specification
sources.release_version_or_commit: Current Google for Developers format specification; no numbered version shown
sources.locator: RIFF file structure; VP8X feature flags; color profile and metadata sections; animation chunks
sources.observed_operation: Extended WebP can carry ICCP, EXIF, XMP, alpha, animation frames and unknown chunks. ICCP is before image data; without ICCP, sRGB should be assumed. Metadata chunks may appear out of order; trailing data may be ignored by readers.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Spec says at most one EXIF/XMP chunk should appear, but readers may ignore extra instances; unknown chunks may be present. A simple WebP file and extended WebP have different feature envelopes.
sources.applicability: Sanitized export should rebuild the RIFF container from pixels and keep only needed alpha/target ICC and animation data; test duplicate, unknown and trailing chunks if accepting WebP.

sources.title: AV1 Image File Format specification
sources.release_version_or_commit: AVIF v1.2.0, listed by the Alliance for Open Media specification page
sources.locator: Sections 1, 4.1, 4.2.2, and item property/reference table; alpha, depth, tone-map/gain-map, derived image and transform properties
sources.observed_operation: AVIF supports HDR/WCG, alpha and auxiliary depth images; tone-map/gain-map derived items may be hidden; item relations include metadata association, auxiliary links, crop, rotation, mirroring and color properties.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AVIF is an ISO-BMFF item graph, not a single raster plus flat tags. Alpha and depth can be auxiliary images; transform and color properties affect interpreted pixels.
sources.applicability: If supported, explicitly traverse and normalize item relationships and properties; sanitized output should construct a fresh item graph and retain only alpha/color/geometry data required for visual interpretation.

sources.title: CIPA Multi-Picture Format standard index
sources.release_version_or_commit: Current standards-page banner announces CIPA DC-007-Translation-2026; detailed card still gives publication 2025-01-24 and history through the 2025 revision
sources.locator: Standards page lines 31-78, Multi-Picture Format entry and its version history
sources.observed_operation: CIPA maintains a separate Multi-Picture Format standard and links a public registry for MP types; accessible page contains a title/date mismatch between its latest banner and detailed card.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The exact current downloadable standard copy was not confirmed in this review; do not infer its clauses from the index.
sources.applicability: Treat MPO/MPF or multi-picture JPEG as unsupported until the exact current standard and decoder/writer behavior are pinned, or test all component images and references.

sources.title: Rust image crate ImageDecoder metadata interface
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10
sources.locator: ImageDecoder provided methods
sources.observed_operation: The decoder trait provides optional EXIF, ICC, IPTC, XMP and orientation accessors, subject to concrete decoder implementation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Trait methods are provided defaults; each format decoder may implement or omit support.
sources.applicability: Rust-native alternative requires per-format capability tests for metadata and orientation, not just a unified interface.

sources.title: Rust image crate Orientation metadata API
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10
sources.locator: Orientation variants; remove_from_exif_chunk
sources.observed_operation: Orientation represents the eight EXIF-compatible transforms; remove_from_exif_chunk reads the orientation and sets it to NoTransforms, and warns that retaining it after applying pixels causes a second transform.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Invalid EXIF values return None and do not modify the chunk.
sources.applicability: Orientation normalization and metadata-reset behavior for a Rust implementation.
